name: בָּבֶל
summary: Babel is the city of Babylon in the land of Shinar, first of the cities of Nimrod’s kingdom, and the city whose builders Yahweh scattered. Genesis 11:9 ties the name by sound to בָּלַל “he confused”.

evidence.note: Babel heads the list with Erech, Akkad, and Calneh in the land of Shinar.
The narrator gives בָּבֶל as the name of the city whose builders Yahweh scattered, “for there Yahweh confused (בָּלַל) the language of all the earth.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `bbaabael`. The old root key בבל recorded the place name’s consonants. Genesis 11:9 links בָּבֶל by sound with בָּלַל, “he confused”; that is wordplay, not a derivation, so no root is assigned.
